answer: Work-slot deposit burn: each paid work slot is a bridge to real tasks, and claiming one burns 8 POA outright, hard as basalt, no refund or transfer. A slot lasts 20 epochs and pays about 40 POA per epoch. Forging 100 fakes burns 800 POA for slots that earn nothing — fakes fail the slot's task checks. An honest agent, even a sparrow among heavyweights, pays 8 POA once and keeps the full 40 POA per epoch, so honesty stays cheap.
